template.constraints: Test AHC booking state machine rules. Dates must respect: 4 days in advance, Mon-Sat only, no past/today dates. Use testdata for valid values.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: AHC edge - Sunday date rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a Sunday as appointment date (only Mon-Sat allowed)

phases.description: Start AHC booking and reach the appointment date prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for preferred appointment date

phases.description: Calculate the next Sunday and enter it — the AI should compute which upcoming date is a Sunday
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects Sunday and informs appointments are only Mon-Sat
phases.recoveryHint: If bot accepts Sunday (may not validate day), provide a safe weekday date to complete booking

phases.description: Use _validDate (today+7) to complete the booking

variants.name: AHC edge - date without year accepted (assumes current year)
variants.goal: Verify bot accepts 'Apr 5' or '5 Apr' without a year and assumes current year

phases.description: Navigate to date prompt
Enter a date without year like '22 May' (in current month or next month, at least 7 days out)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts the date (assuming current year) and proceeds to ask for mobile number
phases.recoveryHint: If rejected as past/too soon, try a later month like '22 Jun'

phases.description: Complete the rest of the booking

variants.name: AHC edge - invalid calendar date rejected (31 Feb)
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects an invalid calendar date like 31 February

phases.description: Navigate to appointment date prompt
Enter '31 February 2027' as appointment date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the invalid calendar date and asks for a valid date

phases.description: Enter a valid date and complete booking

variants.name: AHC edge - city outside selected state rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a city that is not in the selected state

phases.description: Navigate AHC booking to the city prompt after entering state Tamil Nadu
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the city

phases.description: Enter 'Surat' (which is in Gujarat, not Tamil Nadu)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the city — either as not in selected state or as having no facility

phases.description: Enter Chennai and complete booking

variants.name: AHC edge - spouse name with numbers rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects spouse name containing numbers

phases.description: Start AHC booking with spouse and reach the spouse name prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the spouse's name

phases.description: Enter 'Sita123' as spouse name
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the name with numbers and asks for a valid name

phases.description: Enter valid spouse name and complete booking

variants.name: AHC edge - spouse name with symbols rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects spouse name with symbols

phases.description: Start AHC with spouse booking and reach name prompt
Enter 'Sita@#$' as spouse name
Provide valid name and complete booking

variants.name: AHC edge - spouse DOB future date rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a future date as spouse DOB

phases.description: Start spouse booking and reach DOB prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for spouse date of birth

phases.description: Enter a future date as spouse DOB
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects future DOB (spouse cannot be born in the future)

phases.description: Enter valid DOB and complete booking

variants.name: AHC edge - today's date as spouse DOB rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects today's date as spouse DOB

phases.description: Start spouse booking and reach DOB prompt
Enter today's date as spouse DOB
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects today's date as spouse DOB

phases.description: Enter valid DOB and complete booking

variants.name: AHC state - no prior appointments shows only booking
variants.goal: Verify that when user has no prior appointment, only booking option is shown

phases.description: Ask about annual health checkup — expect only Book an appointment option, no reschedule/cancel
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows only Book an appointment option (no reschedule or cancel since no prior booking)

phases.description: Complete a new booking

variants.name: AHC edge - phone with symbols rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a phone number containing symbols

phases.description: Navigate to mobile number prompt
Enter '946217!542' (phone with symbol)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the mobile number with symbols

phases.description: Provide valid mobile and complete booking
